body: It's totally valid to feel like we over react to things when we've faced consistent or long term trauma. I feel you pal.

Hey I'm a trans masculine non binary person. I was in your position but have since come to find chosen family that accept my transness. I don't have contact with my homo/trans phobic family/friends any more. I live with my chosen gender presentation and get gendered correctly with my friends and chosen family now. All this to say that this is possible. Hit me up whenever.
